name: Part of a small fort opposite Canton; Chinese sailing vessel
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view of the 'Red Fort' located on the south bank of the Pearl River, facing the 'factories' (or 'hongs') on the north bank. (This has often been confused with the Haizhu or 'Dutch folly' fort on an island a little further downstream.) For another drawing of the Red Fort see E.1769-1928.
